page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.8xlarge belongs to the Local SSDs instance family and is powered by the KVM hypervisor. It runs on an x86_64 architecture featuring a dedicated 32-vCPU Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 256.0 GB, delivering a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 8.0 GB per core.

Integrated hardware includes 7,679 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth interface of 80 Gbps. No graphical processing units are equipped on this virtual machine, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The dense pairing of high-capacity local solid-state storage with 256.0 GB of memory makes this hardware configuration suitable for I/O-intensive workloads, distributed NoSQL databases, transactional data processing, and large-scale caching layers requiring rapid local data access.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5.8xlarge is a local SSD and memory-dense instance hosted on KVM virtualization. Built on an x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at 3.4 GHz across 32 dedicated vCPUs. The server is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB per core, and includes 7,679 GB of high-speed local SSD storage. Network connectivity features an 80 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The platform does not incorporate GPUs or bundled public IPv4 addresses. With its combination of dedicated compute cores, large RAM footprint, and substantial local solid-state drive capacity, ecs.i5.8xlarge is built for I/O-heavy database workloads, caching clusters, and data processing environments needing high-bandwidth local throughput.
